topic: What Indian creators can build that global tools do badly
angle: The gap is regional, and the models are measurably worse at it
hook: Global AI tools are worst at Indian content
caption:
Every major model is trained overwhelmingly on English and Western imagery. Ask for an Indian wedding, a Telugu voiceover, or a small-town shopfront and quality drops noticeably. That gap is not a complaint. It is the clearest opening available to anyone building here.

🔖 Save this — you'll want it when it's relevant.

#india #aitools #startups #contentcreation #buildinpublic

slides.text: Global AI tools are *worst* at Indian content
Ask any frontier model for something specifically Indian and the quality drops. That is a market, not a grievance.

slides.title: Where it breaks
slides.body: Regional language speech, Indian faces and clothing, festival imagery, small-business settings. All underrepresented in training data, all obvious when the output is wrong.

slides.left_text: Trained on English text and Western imagery. Competent everywhere, excellent for that market.
slides.right_text: Everything specific to here — which is where the customers actually are.

slides.caption: what it costs to fine-tune a model on that gap and find out

slides.title: Start with the job
slides.body: Do not build a model and hunt for buyers. Pick one expensive job — wedding films, shop ads, regional dubbing — and be the best at it using whatever model is cheapest that month.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
